qa.visual_review: Hand empty after release and belt spare retained. Torso rotation changes apparent arm overlap; verify same throwing shoulder/hand with windup before animation. This is a continuity risk, not a proven hand swap.
qa.alpha_note: Outside RGB may contain hidden colors; alpha determines actual visibility. No threshold cleanup applied.
qa.sampling_note: Bounds are single-frame actual content excluding empty canvas, not atlas resolution or display acceptance.
qa.normalization_rule: Do NOT independently normalize crouch/airborne height to idle standing height. Establish fixed scale from stable head/torso bone landmarks in common overlay pass; then align ground foot midpoint. Airborne frame requires motion root and height independent of foot landmarks.
